scanNote:
14-UNITNING OLTINChI (OXIRGI) BETI (103-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '14', chapida 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
21) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: 'nature documentary, amusing personalities, smuggled across the border, face extinction, in captivity, wag its tail, a small price to pay, safe and secure, in danger of, chance of survival'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
22) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and tick how the speaker sounds. Listen again and repeat.' 1 Oh, no! Not again! ☐ scared ☑ angry (namuna). 2 Oh, no! Not again! ☐ bored ☐ puzzled. 3 Really? That's nice! ☐ pleased ☐ shocked. 4 Really? That's nice! ☐ excited ☐ sarcastic. 5 What's the matter? ☐ sad ☐ annoyed. 6 What's the matter? ☐ worried ☐ angry.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing (an opinion article)'.
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: 'When we write AN OPINION ARTICLE, we can divide it into five paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we introduce the topic and clearly STATE OUR OPINION. We use: In my opinion, I believe, etc. We can use RHETORICAL QUESTIONS to introduce the topic (e.g. Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets?). In the SECOND AND THIRD PARAGRAPHS, we give OUR VIEWPOINTS and REASONS. We list our viewpoints with firstly, furthermore, also, etc. In the FOURTH PARAGRAPH, we give the OPPOSING VIEWPOINT and REASONS. We can start with: On the other hand, However, etc. In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we STATE OUR OPINION AGAIN using different words. We normally use PRESENT TENSES in such pieces of writing.'

O'NG USTUN:
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Match the viewpoints to the reasons, then listen and check. Which points support the opinion that rabbits are good house pets? What reasons are given? Which is the opposing view? What reasons are given? Use the notes and the words in the list to talk about rabbits as house pets.' Qiya: 'first, furthermore/also/moreover, on the other hand'. JADVAL (yashil sarlavha '"Rabbits are good house pets." Do you agree?'): Viewpoints: 1 Rabbits are friendly animals. 2 Rabbits don't make noise or a mess. 3 Rabbits can cause problems. Reasons: a They are quiet. It's easy to train them to use a litter tray. They soon learn not to bite or scratch. b They like chewing things and digging holes. They can hurt you if they're scared. c They enjoy being with people. They've got interesting personalities. They love playing. They are great fun to watch. (Oq quyonlar surati.) Ko'k qiya: 'FIRST, rabbits are friendly animals. They enjoy being with people and they've got interesting personalities. MOREOVER, they love playing and ...'
24) 'You have been asked to write an article for a magazine about whether rabbits are good house pets. Use the information from Ex. 23, as well as the plan below, to write an article giving your opinion (150 - 180 words). Use the article in Ex. 19 as a model.' SPIRAL DAFTAR 'Plan': Introduction - Para 1: state your opinion. Main Body - Paras 2, 3: your viewpoints & reasons; Para 4: opposing viewpoint & reasons. Conclusion - Para 5: restate your opinion.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom': 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' Ramkada: • 'Don't keep a dog and bark yourself.' • 'He who rides a tiger is afraid to dismount.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '103'.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an opinion article, we can divide it into five paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Fikr maqolasi yozganda uni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
FIKR MAQOLASI TUZILIShI (5
XATBOShI):

  1 - MAVZU + FIKRIMIZ
      (In my opinion, I believe)
      ⚠ Ritorik savol bilan boshlash
      mumkin: 'Why do people think
      that only dogs and cats make
      good pets?'
  2, 3 - NUQTAI NAZARLARIMIZ +
      SABABLAR (firstly, furthermore,
      also)
  4 - QARAMA-QARShI NUQTAI NAZAR +
      SABABLAR (On the other hand,
      However)
  5 - FIKRIMIZNI QAYTA (boshqa
      so'zlar bilan)

  ⚠ ZAMON: hozirgi zamonlar.


⚠ 'A RHETORICAL QUESTION':

  = ritorik savol (javob
  kutilmaydigan).


⚠ 'TO INTRODUCE THE TOPIC':

  = mavzuni kiritmoq.


⚠ 'TO RESTATE':

  = qayta bayon qilmoq.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we introduce the topic and clearly state our opinion. We use: In my opinion, I believe, etc. We can use rhetorical questions to introduce the topic (e.g. Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets?).
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida mavzuni kiritamiz va fikrimizni aniq bayon qilamiz. 'In my opinion', 'I believe' va h.k. ni ishlatamiz. Mavzuni kiritish uchun ritorik savollardan foydalanishimiz mumkin (masalan, Nega odamlar faqat it va mushuk yaxshi uy hayvoni deb o'ylaydi?).

points.en: In the second and third paragraphs, we give our viewpoints and reasons. We list our viewpoints with firstly, furthermore, also, etc.
points.uz: Ikkinchi va uchinchi xatboshilarda nuqtai nazarlarimiz va sabablarini beramiz. Nuqtai nazarlarimizni 'firstly', 'furthermore', 'also' va h.k. bilan sanaymiz.

points.en: In the fourth paragraph, we give the opposing viewpoint and reasons. We can start with: On the other hand, However, etc.
points.uz: To'rtinchi xatboshida qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazar va sabablarini beramiz. 'On the other hand', 'However' va h.k. bilan boshlashimiz mumkin.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we state our opinion again using different words. We normally use present tenses in such pieces of writing.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida fikrimizni boshqa so'zlar bilan yana bayon qilamiz. Bunday yozma ishlarda odatda hozirgi zamonlarni ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the viewpoints to the reasons, then listen and check. "Rabbits are good house pets." Do you agree?
exercises.instructionUz: Nuqtai nazarlarni sabablarga moslang, keyin tinglang va tekshiring. "Quyonlar yaxshi uy hayvoni." Rozimisiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
MOSLASh:
  1 friendly animals → c (enjoy
    being with people, interesting
    personalities, love playing,
    fun to watch)
  2 don't make noise or a mess → a
    (quiet, litter tray, don't bite
    or scratch)
  3 can cause problems → b (chew
    things, dig holes, can hurt you)


SAVOLLAR:
  Quyonlar yaxshi uy hayvoni degan
  fikrni 1 va 2 qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
  Qarama-qarshi fikr - 3.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'FIRST, rabbits are friendly
   animals. They enjoy being with
   people and they've got
   interesting personalities.
   MOREOVER, they love playing
   and ...'


⚠ 'TO MAKE A MESS':

  = iflos qilmoq, tartibsizlik
  qilmoq.


⚠ 'A LITTER TRAY':

  = hojatxona qutisi (uy hayvoni
  uchun).


⚠ 'TO SCRATCH':

  = tirnamoq.


⚠ 'TO CHEW':

  = chaynamoq, kemirmoq.


⚠ 'TO DIG HOLES':

  = chuqur qazmoq.


⚠ 'MOREOVER':

  = bundan tashqari (= furthermore).

pairs.right: c They enjoy being with people. They've got interesting personalities. They love playing. They are great fun to watch.
pairs.rightUz: c Ular odamlar bilan bo'lishni yoqtiradi. Ular qiziqarli xarakterga ega. Ular o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi. Ularni tomosha qilish juda qiziq.

pairs.left: 2 Rabbits don't make noise or a mess.
pairs.right: a They are quiet. It's easy to train them to use a litter tray. They soon learn not to bite or scratch.
pairs.rightUz: a Ular jim. Ularni hojatxona qutisidan foydalanishga o'rgatish oson. Ular tez orada tishlamaslik va tirnamaslikni o'rganadi.

pairs.right: b They like chewing things and digging holes. They can hurt you if they're scared.
pairs.rightUz: b Ular narsalarni kemirish va chuqur qazishni yoqtiradi. Qo'rqsa, sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes and the words in the list to talk about rabbits as house pets. first, furthermore/also/moreover, on the other hand

⚠ Bog'lovchilar bilan:

exercises.exampleEn: First, rabbits are friendly animals. They enjoy being with people and they've got interesting personalities. Moreover, they love playing and they are great fun to watch.
exercises.exampleUz: Avvalo, quyonlar do'stona hayvonlar. Ular odamlar bilan bo'lishni yoqtiradi va qiziqarli xarakterga ega. Bundan tashqari, ular o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi va ularni tomosha qilish juda qiziq.
modelAnswers: Furthermore, rabbits don't make noise or a mess. They are quiet, it's easy to train them to use a litter tray, and they soon learn not to bite or scratch.
On the other hand, rabbits can cause problems. They like chewing things and digging holes, and they can hurt you if they're scared.
modelAnswersUz: Bundan tashqari, quyonlar shovqin va iflos qilmaydi. Ular jim, ularni hojatxona qutisidan foydalanishga o'rgatish oson va ular tez orada tishlamaslik va tirnamaslikni o'rganadi.
Boshqa tomondan, quyonlar muammo keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Ular narsalarni kemirish va chuqur qazishni yoqtiradi, qo'rqsa sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: You have been asked to write an article for a magazine about whether rabbits are good house pets. Use the information from Ex. 23, as well as the plan below, to write an article giving your opinion (150 - 180 words). Use the article in Ex. 19 as a model.

structure.modelEn: Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets? In my opinion, rabbits make wonderful house pets, too.
structure.modelUz: Nega odamlar faqat it va mushuk yaxshi uy hayvoni deb o'ylaydi? Mening fikrimcha, quyonlar ham ajoyib uy hayvoni.

structure.modelEn: First of all, rabbits are friendly animals. They enjoy being with people and they've got interesting personalities. They love playing and they are great fun to watch.
structure.modelUz: Avvalo, quyonlar do'stona hayvonlar. Ular odamlar bilan bo'lishni yoqtiradi va qiziqarli xarakterga ega. Ular o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi va ularni tomosha qilish juda qiziq.

structure.modelEn: Furthermore, rabbits don't make noise or a mess. They are quiet animals, and it's easy to train them to use a litter tray. They also soon learn not to bite or scratch.
structure.modelUz: Bundan tashqari, quyonlar shovqin va iflos qilmaydi. Ular jim hayvonlar, ularni hojatxona qutisidan foydalanishga o'rgatish oson. Ular tez orada tishlamaslik va tirnamaslikni ham o'rganadi.

structure.modelEn: On the other hand, rabbits can cause problems. They like chewing things and digging holes, and they can hurt you if they're scared. However, if you look after them properly, these problems are small.
structure.modelUz: Boshqa tomondan, quyonlar muammo keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Ular narsalarni kemirish va chuqur qazishni yoqtiradi, qo'rqsa sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Biroq, ularga to'g'ri qarasangiz, bu muammolar kichik.

structure.modelEn: All in all, I believe that rabbits are perfect pets for people who want a quiet, friendly and amusing companion.
structure.modelUz: Umuman olganda, quyonlar jim, do'stona va kulgili hamroh xohlagan odamlar uchun mukammal uy hayvoni deb ishonaman.

modelAnswers:
Why do people think that only dogs and cats make good pets? In my opinion, rabbits make wonderful house pets, too.

First of all, rabbits are friendly animals. They enjoy being with people and they've got interesting personalities. They love playing and they are great fun to watch.

Furthermore, rabbits don't make noise or a mess. They are quiet animals, and it's easy to train them to use a litter tray. They also soon learn not to bite or scratch.

On the other hand, rabbits can cause problems. They like chewing things and digging holes, and they can hurt you if they're scared. However, if you look after them properly, these problems are small.

All in all, I believe that rabbits are perfect pets for people who want a quiet, friendly and amusing companion.
modelAnswersUz:
Nega odamlar faqat it va mushuk yaxshi uy hayvoni deb o'ylaydi? Mening fikrimcha, quyonlar ham ajoyib uy hayvoni.

Avvalo, quyonlar do'stona hayvonlar. Ular odamlar bilan bo'lishni yoqtiradi va qiziqarli xarakterga ega. Ular o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi va ularni tomosha qilish juda qiziq.

Bundan tashqari, quyonlar shovqin va iflos qilmaydi. Ular jim hayvonlar, ularni hojatxona qutisidan foydalanishga o'rgatish oson. Ular tez orada tishlamaslik va tirnamaslikni ham o'rganadi.

Boshqa tomondan, quyonlar muammo keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Ular narsalarni kemirish va chuqur qazishni yoqtiradi, qo'rqsa sizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Biroq, ularga to'g'ri qarasangiz, bu muammolar kichik.

Umuman olganda, quyonlar jim, do'stona va kulgili hamroh xohlagan odamlar uchun mukammal uy hayvoni deb ishonaman.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
1) 'Don't keep a dog and bark
   yourself.'
   = It saqlab, o'zing hurma.
   MA'NOSI: birovga ish topshirgan
   bo'lsang, o'sha ishni o'zing
   qilma.

2) 'He who rides a tiger is afraid
   to dismount.'
   = Yo'lbars mingan odam tushishga
   qo'rqadi.
   MA'NOSI: xavfli ishni boshlagan
   odam uni to'xtatishga qo'rqadi -
   to'xtatish davom ettirishdan
   xavfliroq.


⚠ 'TO BARK':

  = hurmoq.


⚠ 'TO DISMOUNT':

  = (otdan) tushmoq.
  ⚠ 'to mount' = minmoq.


⚠ 'HE WHO ...':

  = ... qilgan odam (maqollarda).

items.en: Don't keep a dog and bark yourself.
items.answerEn: If you have someone to do a job for you, don't do it yourself.
items.answerUz: Agar biror ishni siz uchun qiladigan odam bo'lsa, uni o'zingiz qilmang.

items.en: He who rides a tiger is afraid to dismount.
items.answerEn: When you start something dangerous, it can be more dangerous to stop than to continue.
items.answerUz: Xavfli ishni boshlaganingizda, to'xtatish davom ettirishdan xavfliroq bo'lishi mumkin.
